system.description:
• Effect: Cast arcane folk-magic spells, learned from a patron, per the Spells Per Day table.
  • You prepare spells each morning from the whole Witch list (see Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).
  • A Witch comes to each new level of spells later than a Wizard or Cleric does: her Hex and her cauldron carry the years between.
